title: A point in the closure of the image of a morphism lies in the space of its scheme theoretic image
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a morphism of algebraic stacks a point lying in the closure of the image of the morphism is a point of the space of its scheme theoretic image (author lemma at source lines 8986-8992, label lemma-topology-scheme-theoretic-image). The proof (source lines 8994-9016) localises at the point, base changes along a smooth cover of the target by an affine scheme, replaces the base-changed source by an affine scheme covering it, uses density of the image in the scheme case, and concludes with openness of the map on spaces (proof lines 8994-9015). The base change step and the final topology argument are the content. H3.
